title: Nutritious Grassy Syrian Lamb Wrap
description: A low-calorie Syrian dish featuring mature cheddar and fresh grassy flavors, wrapped in a ssam-wrap and cooked to perfection in a wok. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with a healthy twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook for 5 minutes until browned on all sides.
Add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes until the lamb is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and mint.
Warm the ssam-wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the lamb and placing it in the center of each ssam-wrap piece, topping with shredded mature cheddar.
